visual_action: A montage shows Air Force One and an Air China plane on a tarmac. This is followed by various scenes of a diplomatic meeting between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. They shake hands in front of American and Chinese flags, sit at a conference table (where Marco Rubio is also visible), walk together out of a building, and shake hands again. The video concludes with a black screen featuring a white line-art graphic of the White House.
